items.q: On USG the radiological clue for RAS is asymmetric kidney; the screening test is:
items.exp: On USG: asymmetric kidney; screening test: renal doppler. (Book p751)

items.q: The investigation of choice to confirm renal artery stenosis is:
opts: CT renal angio or MR angiography
items.exp: IOC: CT renal angio or MR angiography (confirms the doppler screen). (Book p751)

items.q: The drug of choice written for unilateral RAS is:
Percutaneous transluminal renal angioplasty (PTRA) is offered only if the kidney size is above:
items.exp: PTRA – only if kidney size > 8 cm. (Book p751)
